Subject: Renewal orchestration & capacity uplift — kickoff & QBR timing

Hi Lisa —

Hope you had a great weekend. NovaPlay’s annual renewal is coming up in September and I wanted to kick off coordination so we can align on term, expected capacity increases, and a QBR cadence. High-level items I want to cover:

- Renewal term & any requested changes to data residency/retention
- Capacity bump: you mentioned +30% steady-state token volume and 2x peak bursts on play days
- Commercials: pricing tiers for committed baseline vs burst buffer and any credit considerations
- Security/compliance asks for procurement (SOC2 artifacts, IP flow doc, support SLA)
- Suggested QBR agenda and stakeholder list

Proposed timeline:
- Week of Aug 9: internal prep + collect usage/ops data (I’ve attached the Q2 usage export)
- Week of Aug 16: joint renewal kickoff with NovaPlay + procurement & security representation
- Week of Aug 23–27: finalize SOW and pricing, circulate for signatures
- Early Sept: QBR and go-live for increased capacity (if agreed)

Can we book a 30–45 minute kickoff the week of Aug 16? I’m available Tue/Thu mornings PT; if that doesn’t work please propose a time. I’ve attached a draft SOW and the Q2 usage snapshot for your review.

Attachments: NovaPlay_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf (draft SOW), usage_report_q2.csv

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,

Camila Reyes

Camila —

Thanks for the clear plan. Week of Aug 16 works. Please include our procurement and our ML infra lead (I’ll loop them in below) — procurement will want the SOC2 evidence and standard terms redline ahead of the kickoff. A couple quick notes from our side:

- We do expect the +30% steady-state and 2x peak calls during our marquee events in October; we’d like the burst buffer to be available starting Oct 1.
- Can you indicate any committed discount thresholds for a 12–24 month term vs month-to-month?
- Security: we’ll need the SOC2 report and details on KV cache isolation for customer data before signing.

I’ve CC’d procurement. If you can share a short pre-read (SOW + costs + SOC2 pointer) before Aug 13 that would be ideal.

Thanks,

Camila / Monica —

I can take pricing and SOW language. Initial thoughts:

- Pricing: recommend we present a baseline committed tier at current $/1k tokens and a tiered discount at 12mo (7%) and 24mo (12%), with an explicit burst buffer rate (higher) to avoid overcommitting. If they want a guaranteed burst pool we should price that as reserved capacity (monthly commit).
- Credits/one-time concessions: I’m OK with a small onboarding credit if they sign a 12mo. Keep retail credits limited to one quarter.
- SOW: will prepare an amendment that adds a burst buffer clause, outlines SLA for provisioning (1–2 business days for configured burst), and includes a brief security appendix referencing SOC2 and KMS/HSM options.

I’ll draft the pricing slide + SOW addendum by Aug 11 and share for review. Thu Aug 6 at 10 PT works for me.

-Marissa
